title: Chart and table
pitch: Pick a sample in the table and the chart's crosshair follows; move along the chart and the row follows.
makeItYours: Chart your own samples: a build's durations, a service's latency, a disk's free space.
Give the table and the chart the same selection key and keep their rows in the same order.
Label the points with times so the readout says when each value was taken.
useCase: Use it when a table of measurements is easier to read with its trend beside it, and the trend needs exact values.
